items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: But Ace Watson was the best in the Orleans. Best Marshall in the Orleans.

ctx.x: That's right. And I don't call them no Marshalls. But Ace Watson was the best in the Orleans. Best Marshall in the Orleans. And he was dignified with what he did you know what I mean. And when he brought them funerals out there was a funeral.
Well what makes a Marshall good now? He's got to be dignified. Steady kind of fella. As he walks. Now what has he got to do though? What's his job exactly? I don't know.
